author: Corridor Crew
description:
A few weeks back, Rockstar released an extended trailer of GTA VI that absolutely blew our minds. What makes it even more impressive is that they captured all the footage directly on a PlayStation 5. 

How is it even possible that a game that looks this good can run on a PS5? It turns out that Rockstar has a few tricks up their sleeve.
title: This is why GTA VI won't melt your PS5.
